name: mm-office-runway
description: No bundler: the site is plain ES modules. These scripts are dev tooling only.

scripts.validate: npx -y ajv-cli@5 validate --spec=draft7 -s src/contracts/avatar.schema.json -d "data/avatars/*.json" && node scripts/build-avatar-index.mjs
scripts.check: npm run validate && for f in config.js $(find src scripts -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo '✓ syntax ok'
